updates.note: Management highlights long-term double-digit growth potential over the next 5-15 years.
updates.quote: And we are here for the next 5 years, 10 years, 15 years. So this is a story which is going to play out.

updates.note: Capex for India is guided to be about Rs. 1,000 crore.
updates.quote: It is about Rs. 1,000 crore in India and about $90 million would be international.

updates.note: Management expects to add a couple of 100,000 outlets every year.
updates.quote: And we are hoping to add a couple of 100,000 outlets every year.

new_promises.statement: International markets combined capex will be between $90 million and $100 million.
new_promises.quote: combined capex for all these is under $100 million, maybe anything between $90 million to $100 million for the international markets.
new_promises.speaker: Raj Gandhi
